messages:
Maya S: Quick postmortem follow-up — we saw a new pattern of partial response + silent close on /v1/streaming-chat last night, tagging owners and proposed actions.
Lin (SRE): Ack. Can you paste the minimal repro/trace?
Maya S: Dumping snippet from logs: 
```
connection_id=abcd1234 status=200 stream_end=unexpected bytes_sent=1024 last_event=token_chunk
error=EOF client_ip=10.2.3.4
```
Raj P: Looks like client got a half-chunk then connection closed. Could be heartbeats or proxy idle. Adding probe for TCP FIN/RST in next rollout.
Sam - Infra: I will add a tcpdump wrapper in the streaming ingress pod and a separate filter for half-chunk events. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Emily C: For immediate mitigation, can we extend the ALB idle-timeout and add a 10s keepalive from the runtime?
Nick T: Extending ALB idle timeout + keepalive sounds low-risk. I'll open the infra change request.
OpsBot: Deploy request created: #DEP-8472; reviewers: @Nick T, @Sam - Infra.
Lin (SRE): Ownership: Raj will own detection (alerts + dashboards), Sam owns packet-level capture, Nick owns infra changes, Maya to coordinate QA + customer comms.
Maya S: Agreed. Also adding a new automated check to catch partial-chunk patterns in prod logs (error ratio > 0.1% over 5m). Raj, can you draft the query?
Raj P: Draft query pushed to Grafana board, link: https://internal.redwood/boards/streaming/partial-chunk-detection — need someone to sanity-check thresholds.
Emily C: I'll validate on canary traffic later today. If it spikes, we should auto-trigger an incident with immediate rollbacks to previous routing layer.
Nick T: IR plan: if partial-chunk rate > 0.5% persist > 10m, revert ALB config and route new sessions to fallback model variant in us-west-2.
Maya S: Timeline: detection rules + alert by 24h; infra change (ALB keepalive) by 48h; tcpdump and analysis by 72h; postmortem update and customer notes by 96h.
Sam - Infra: Noted; I'll coordinate the tcpdump runbooks and upload pcap to the incident folder.
Lin (SRE): Also let's add a reconnect-backoff improvement in client-side SDK: jitter + capped exponential backoff and resume-on-409 logic. Suggesting small patch: 
```
reconnect_delay_ms = min(1000 * 2**attempt, 30000) + rand(0,200)
if status == 409 then resume_from_kv_cache()
```
Raj P: Good. I'll add unit tests for resume_on_409 and a synthetic that injects mid-stream closes.
Maya S: Communication: I'll prepare a short status update for affected customers and post on status.redwood.ai once we have ALB rollback criteria.
Emily C: FYI — there was a similar recurring pattern in Feb that had a proxy idle bug. I added that tag to the postmortem so we can detect recurrence.
Maya S: Closing asks: 1) Raj — detection + dashboard, 2) Sam — packet capture + runbook, 3) Nick — ALB keepalive change + rollback plan, 4) Lin — SDK reconnect patch review, 5) Emily — canary validation + prev-incident correlation, 6) Maya — customer comms draft. Please update JIRA tickets with progress.
Nick T: I'll aim to have the infra PR open within 6 hours.
Sam - Infra: tcpdump wrapper PR by EOD.
Raj P: Detection rule and grafana panel ready for review.
Lin (SRE): I'll review the SDK patch tomorrow morning.
Maya S: Thanks all. I'll run a 15-min sync tomorrow 10:30am to ensure we hit timelines. If anything blocks, ping here. :thumbsup:
